scope: Retained String, StringBuilder and Error ownership, live replacement, byte snapshots and finalization acceptance through Oops
representation_checks: String handles have zero payload bytes; ObjectModel slot access rejects them.

All 64 wrapper finalizers forward successfully, reject String allocation, and observe zero reclaimed objects from recursive collection.
String, Error and StringBuilder prototypes survive release of test roots.
